name: margai-monorepo
description: MargAI: Smartphone-first road safety and civic intelligence system for Google Startup Buildathon India 2026

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/localization && npm run build -w packages/risk-engine
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w services/assistance && npm run build -w services/api
scripts.build:web: npm run prepare:vision && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev -w services/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build:ui-preview: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-ui-preview.mjs
